title: Efficient Polynomial-Time Decoding of Simplicial Anticodes with Near-Optimal Performance
summary: In this work, we propose an efficient decoding algorithm for codes arising from simplicial complexes, a family of binary linear codes for which no decoding method of this type was previously known. Although the algorithm does not always attain the maximum theoretical error-correcting capability, it provides an explicit bound that can be computed directly from the structure of the complex.
